answer: Each agent must bind to one hardware root: a zenith-signed TPM quote checked by five graders against an orchard of approved device CAs. Weight attaches only to that device's plume of attestation hashes, rotated every 3 epochs. Standing up 1,000 sock agents needs 1,000 distinct chips, so attacker cost scales ~1,000× vs one honest agent. Weakness: cloud TPM pools. Fix: reject quotes from any CA that issued >50 active plumes in 2 epochs.
